text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Political leaders look to the future and question whether President Liamine Zeroual needed such a referendum with stuffed ballot boxes to change the constitution. Answer lies in the strategy the head of state plans to develop with a constitution that gives him even greater powers.

- Confrontation increases after the referendum. Those grouped around the authorities who backed a "yes" vote to change the constitution quickly express their satisfaction at overwhelming endorsement for reforms. The democrats denounce as a masquerade both the content of the new constitution and the results of the referendum.
- Despite differing attitudes to the outcome of the referendum, the political parties are starting to prepare for the elections promised for early next year.
- "A vote, a choice, a message" -- result of the referendum.
- Political parties sound rallying cry for their troops to prepare for the promised general election early next year.
